scripts.lint: npm run bootstrap && vally lint --eval-spec eval.yaml && vally lint --eval-spec controls/eval.yaml
scripts.lint:ct24: npm run bootstrap && vally lint --eval-spec eval.ct24.yaml && node scripts/verify-ct24-spec.mjs
scripts.dry-run: npm run bootstrap && vally experiment run experiment.yaml --dry-run
scripts.dry-run:ct24: npm run bootstrap && vally experiment run experiment.ct24.yaml --dry-run
scripts.experiment:ct24: npm run bootstrap && node scripts/run-experiment.mjs experiment.ct24.yaml
scripts.bridge:custom: npm run bootstrap && (cd ../.. && dotnet publish src/grounding -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained --nologo) && node scripts/run-custom-bridge.mjs
scripts.test: node --test && (cd ../.. && dotnet build src/grounding -c Release --nologo --verbosity quiet) && node scripts/verify-grounding-adapter.mjs
